verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical skyscraper reflows. Both spread the blocks evenly down the canvas with large dead gaps between them, so related copy loses its grouping. Both move the URL above the event-details copy, which breaks the original reading order, and that small body text is tiny and hard to read at 160px wide. A's pink subhead also leaves 'VIRTUAL' alone on its own line and sets the 'IT'S TIME…' line smaller and weaker. B wraps the pink subhead more cleanly and gives the 'IT'S TIME…' line more weight, so its hierarchy is slightly better.
